hooks.text: The Big Bang was never an explosion into empty space.
There was never an empty void for the universe to explode into.
What room did the Big Bang actually explode into?

title: The Big Bang Never Exploded
description: The Big Bang was not a bomb bursting into an empty void. In 1927, a physicist priest proved that space itself stretched everywhere at once.

beats.text: The Big Bang was never an explosion into empty space.
beats.visual: WMAP diagram of the expanding universe timeline, 2006
queries: WMAP expansion timeline of the universe diagram
CMB timeline of the universe expansion illustration NASA

beats.text: In 1929, Edwin Hubble observed distant galaxies racing away through California's Mount Wilson telescope.
beats.visual: Edwin Hubble at the Mount Wilson 100-inch Hooker telescope, 1937
queries: Edwin Hubble Mount Wilson 100-inch Hooker telescope

beats.text: Rewind 380,000 years after the start, and that expanding space squeezes into an opaque, glowing plasma.
beats.visual: Planck satellite all-sky map of the cosmic microwave background, 2013
queries: Planck CMB full sky all-sky map 2013
Planck cosmic microwave background temperature fluctuations

beats.text: Rewind to the first split second of inflation, and the cosmos shrinks down to microscopic quantum fluctuations.
beats.visual: Artist concept of cosmic inflation and early universe expansion, 2010

beats.text: At the beginning, all matter in the universe collapses into a single primordial atom.
beats.visual: Diagram showing all cosmic matter compressed into a primordial atom, 2008

beats.text: There was no surrounding darkness, because space itself was expanding everywhere at once.
beats.visual: Computer simulation of expanding space and cosmic web structure, 2014
queries: Illustris simulation cosmic web large scale structure

beats.text: In 1927, Belgian Catholic priest Georges Lemaître deduced that astronomical redshifts proved space was expanding.
beats.visual: Photograph of Belgian physicist and priest Georges Lemaitre, 1933

beats.text: His math proved there was never an outside void waiting to be filled.
beats.visual: Wide view of deep space showing distant galaxies and stretching spacetime, 2020
queries: deep space galaxies field view NASA

better_than_last: Applies the scale ladder structure to bust the explosion myth by rewinding cosmic scale step-by-step from fleeing galaxies to a primordial atom, concluding with a seamless rewatch loop.
